title: Get through: Pass an Exam: Meaning and Examples — Word Power 19
content:
## Get through: Pass an Exam

**Word Power 19 · Phrasal verbs**

### Meaning

To be successful in an exam.

### Usage

1. He has got through his exam.
2. Work hard if you want to get through this exam.

### How to use it

In this sense, get through means successfully pass an examination or selection stage. Name the examination after through. Unlike pass, through cannot simply be dropped from the expression.

### Another example

With regular revision, she got through the written examination and reached the interview stage.

### Check your understanding

Correct: He got the entrance examination through last year.

### Suggested answer

He got through the entrance examination last year. Keep get through together before the examination in this meaning.
